findings.explanation: Order is toys/premium, gross 5114.31, expected commission = 17% * 5114.31 = 869.43 (no low-ticket fee, unit_price 1704.77 >= 79). Settlement row ST-0300021 charged fee -969.16, i.e. 99.73 BRL more than the contractual commission. Shipping (-21.90, standard) matches expectation, so the entire delta is an excess commission charge.

Order is home/premium, gross 2006.08, expected commission = 17% * 2006.08 = 341.03 (unit_price 1003.04 >= 79, no low-ticket fee). Settlement row ST-0300006 charged fee -400.21, 59.18 BRL above the contractual commission. Shipping (-39.90, heavy) matches expectation, isolating the delta to the commission line.

Order MLB-030022 (electronics/premium, gross 64.74, qty 1) should settle once for net 48.13 (commission 16% + 6.25 low-ticket fee = 16.61). Two identical payment rows were posted: ST-0300026 (2026-07-18) and ST-0300057 (2026-07-19), each gross 64.74 / fee -16.61 / net 48.13, both carrying the full fee (not a legitimate split, which would put fees only on the first row). The order was paid out twice for a total net of 96.26 instead of 48.13.

Order MLB-030048 (fashion/classic, gross 42.15, delivered) has zero settlement rows. Expected: commission 13% + 6.25 low-ticket fee (unit_price 42.15 < 79) = 11.73, no shipping deducted (gross < 79), expected net = 30.42. No payment row exists on the statement at all.
